name: RAIZNEXT Corporation
summary: RAIZNEXT Corporation engages in providing engineering and maintanance services in Japan. The company is involved in production, procurement, maintenance, sales, leasing, designing, supervising, and constructing of equipment and machinery; and maintenance of installations and equipment. It also provides installation, civil engineering, electrical instrumentation, and plumbing services; and research, development, technical support, and its consignment.
